release.notes_on_special_items: Q2-2022 release: Adjusted EBITDA 'excluding Russia' (= core). Russia figures are total-company; Russia sits in EMEA & APAC (footnote: Russia net sales included within EMEA & APAC), so EMEA russia_adj_ebitda=11.9 and EMEA core 54.8 (=66.7-11.9) are derived; Americas Russia 0 by that footnote. Segment Adjusted EBITA: Americas 34.3, EMEA & APAC 60.8, Total 95.1 (10-Q: 34,273 / 60,808 / 95,081 thousand). Adjusted tax rate 22.0% (2021 incl. exclusion of some non-recurring benefits). Russia adjusted EPS 0.15.

notes: Form 10 Information Statement (Ex.99.1, 10-12B/A filed 2022-03-17) now used: audited combined (carve-out) statements FY2019-FY2021 of the 'Fabrication Technology Business of Colfax Corporation', summary historical data (covers 2019-2021 only), MD&A and notes. The Form 10 has no EPS for historical periods (pro forma 2021 only) and no interim (2021 quarterly / Sep-2021) statements.

Pre-spin carve-out (combined) presentation: ESAB was the Fabrication Technology business of Colfax/Enovis until the April 4, 2022 Separation. Asbestos-holding entities, certain pension plans and debt were contributed at Separation and are NOT in 2019-2021 statements (10-K Note 1).
EPS for pre-spin periods computed by the company on 60,034,311 shares (shares distributed at Separation); basic = diluted. No dividends declared pre-spin (dps_declared=0).
Q2-2021 includes Pension settlement gain (11,208) thousand (non-operating).
CF 'Proceeds from borrowings on term credit facility 274' mapped to debt_proceeds; distributions to NCI in other_financing; pension settlement gain in other_noncash.

10-Q segment net sales: Americas 253,629, EMEA & APAC 376,175 thousand; Adjusted EBITA 34,273 / 60,808 / 95,081 thousand. 10-Q EBITA recon: Separation costs 106, Amortization of acquired intangibles 9,104, Other 182 thousand.
Release: Russia net sales Q2-2021 44.0 (EMEA & APAC). Adj EBITDA excl. Russia 92.8; margin excl. Russia 15.8%.
Q1-2022 release (earlier version) also showed Q2-2021 segment table: identical values (OI 27.1/55.1/82.2, adj EBITDA 38.0/66.7/104.7).
